title: Message
description: The base unit of structured text. A `Message` includes an `author` and the `content` of the `Message`. The `author` is used to tag messages when they are fed to the model as text.

author.description: Optional. The author of this Message. This serves as a key for tagging the content of this Message when it is fed to the model as text. The author can be any alphanumeric string.

content.description: Required. The text content of the structured `Message`.
